THE PROBLEM WORTH SOLVING

A complete file can still miss the job dates.

A contractor pack can contain an insurance schedule or training certificate that does not cover the planned work. The reviewer needs to compare the evidence with the actual job requirement.

Read the operating problem
WHY NOW

Read the requirement beside the document.

Extracting a date is only useful when it is compared with a job’s dates and scope. A repeatable evidence review can keep changing contractor documents attached to the requirement they are meant to satisfy.

See the product workflow
